subject.title: Feature: Cross-platform multi-select component in message tool

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a portable batch-selection message-presentation contract, and which channel implementations and fallback behavior must be guaranteed before it is exposed through the public SDK?
rationale: This changes the public message-tool and plugin SDK contract across channel boundaries; source evidence establishes the gap but cannot choose the durable capability matrix or fallback promise.

options.title: Adopt a portable batch-selection contract
options.body: Add an additive typed action with array-valued callbacks, explicit capability metadata, documented fallbacks, and channel-owned native rendering.

options.title: Keep structured selection channel-specific
options.body: Expose native multi-select or modal capabilities through the owning channel plugins without promising a cross-platform message-tool primitive.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep the scalar portable select contract until a maintainer-sponsored interaction roadmap defines the required channels and fallback guarantees.

recommendation.title: Adopt a portable batch-selection contract
recommendation.body: Add an additive typed action with array-valued callbacks, explicit capability metadata, documented fallbacks, and channel-owned native rendering.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main presentation-contract history and the prior maintainer-facing review point to this area as the closest available routing signal.
